final_message:
Here's what I updated based on our conversation:

**Updated:** Your "Claims workflow redesign" achievement (A-001) now reflects the full story — leading requirements work for motor claims intake automation, running cross-team workshops, mapping the process, writing functional requirements, and helping define API payloads. I added the outcome (18→7 min claim-registration time, ~120 handlers using it) and the November 2025 go-live date, plus related skills (requirements gathering, process mapping, workshop facilitation, API requirements).

**Added:** A "Cross-team dependency coordination" skill — based on your clarification that you coordinated with the engineering manager and tracked dependencies, rather than formally managing the 8-person engineering team. I did **not** record the initial "managed the entire engineering team" claim, since you walked it back.

**Held back:** Your cloud architecture certification — "cloud architecture certification" matched two possible credentials in the registry (AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate and Google Professional Cloud Architect), so I can't safely store it as supported yet. I've asked which one it is; once confirmed I'll add it.
